summary: Defines a new BGP encoding that lets routers share traffic flow specifications, which are rules matching particular kinds of traffic, such as by destination prefix and other packet fields. This lets the routing system spread finer-grained filtering information than a plain destination prefix, often to help block unwanted traffic. It was replaced by RFC 8955.

eli5.summary: Normally a road sign says only which town a road leads to. This adds extra signs such as which kinds of trucks to stop, and passes them to every nearby road.

questions: how to distribute traffic filter rules with bgp
